purpose: Source-selected v11_04d output-only equivalence and actual post-initialization start/state gate. No timing intervention in this stage.

conditions.absent: CSP_POSTINIT_DSHIFT unset; exact uninstrumented science-output equality mandatory
conditions.plus: Actual postnative-init D plus0.2 mag, all other entries unchanged
conditions.minus: Actual postnative-init D minus0.2 mag, all other entries unchanged

inputs: Byte-identical to passed baseline2021 including NML3iterations, historicalMW94,B18, fixedshape1,AV0,fixedheaderpeak; no truth-header repair.

gates.FITRES_columns_and_SN_lines: exact baseline equality for absent and zero
gates.LCPLOT: exact bytes for absent and zero
gates.all_conditions: 8objects ERRFLAG0, finite positive C, native accepted row/data/error identity, fixedcoordinates, MJDOFF0, covariance/objective state saved
gates.scope: Data Q plus exported prior/sigma term is native minimand for that iteration. Different iteration C/prior state is not a common likelihood; no cross-state objective minimum selection.

amplitude_check: Frozen C analytic amplitude is diagnostic only. Native SNooPy distance scaling is multiplicative; use positive interior amplitude, preserve nonpositive/model/domain failures. It neither replaces native optimization nor changes C.
execution: Requires separately hashed root release and exclusive native worker. Freeze inputs and runner before release. Preserve every failure and all4branches. No automatic iteration or tolerance expansion.
